title: Aromantic Rendezvous
author: Daniel Wallick
problems: The progression after row 2 "right diagonal robins chain" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must stand side by side to find new neighbors.
Row 3 "neighbors promenade" can't start from where the dancers are: To promenade across, neighbors must stand side by side on one side.
Row 5 "robins dance out while larks dance in to a long wave in the center - balance the wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 1 is not in the center to dance out.
Row 6 "larks allemande left ½" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 4 and 6 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 2 "right diagonal robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the right diagonal.
choices: Square through: each balance takes 4 beats and each pull by 2.
